title: Behind Aggregate Scores: What Systematically Varying Arena-Hard's LLM Judge Reveals
abstract: arXiv:2610.30512v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM judges are used to determine which of two answers is better. Trusting these verdicts requires knowing how repeatable they are and how much they depend on the judge's instructions. We show that similar aggregate scores can conceal substantial changes in individual verdicts, both when the same setup is repeated and when the instructions change. Using 500 Arena-Hard v2.0 prompts with two models' answers held fixed, we run GPT-4.1 as the judge under all eight combinations of criteria, output format and task framing, and repeat every setup unchanged at temperature zero on a pinned model version. Rerunning the default setup moves the aggregate score by about one point but changes the win/tie/loss outcome on 21.2% of prompts. translated_title: 总分背后：系统性改变Arena-Hard的LLM评判者所揭示的问题
translated_abstract: LLM评判者（judge）被用来判定两个答案中哪一个更好。信任这些裁决需要了解它们的可重复性如何，以及它们在多大程度上依赖于评判者的指令。我们表明，相似的总分可能掩盖单个裁决中的实质性变化，无论是在重复相同设置时，还是在指令发生改变时。我们使用500个Arena-Hard v2.0提示词并固定两个模型的答案，让GPT-4.1作为评判者，在评估标准、输出格式和任务框架的所有八种组合下运行，并在固定的模型版本上以温度为零的设置原样重复每种设置。重新运行默认设置会使总分变动约一分，但在21.2%的提示词上改变了胜/平/负的结果。指令的改变引入了进一步的敏感性：在一个要求直接给出裁决而无需推理、并删除了其他几项指令的设置中，结果发生变化的提示词比例比……（原文截断）多出28.2个百分点。
tldr: 该研究通过系统性地改变Arena-Hard评测中LLM评判者的标准、输出格式与任务指令，发现相似的总分掩盖了大量个别评判结果的差异——即使在温度为零且固定模型版本的条件下重复运行，仍有21.2%的提示词的胜/平/负结果会改变，表明LLM评测的可靠性存在被忽视的隐患。
en_tdlr: By systematically varying the criteria, output format, and task instructions of Arena-Hard's LLM judge, this study reveals that similar aggregate scores conceal substantial changes in individual verdicts—even rerunning the default setup at temperature zero with a pinned model version changes win/tie/loss outcomes on 21.2% of prompts, highlighting overlooked reliability issues in LLM-based evaluation.
